It is also a reflection of the spiritual purity and innocence sought after by followers of Christ. Additionally, the lily holds special significance as a symbol of the Virgin Mary, who embodies both purity and motherhood. Thus, the name "Lirio" may be given to a child as a reminder of the purity, innocence, and spiritual significance found in the Christian faith.
